name: tint
description: A calm color set for the Claude Desktop app: Herbstglut, Rosé Pine, Nord, or colors from your own design system, in light and dark. Colors only, no background.

enabled.title: Apply colors
enabled.description: Off leaves the app's own colors. Also /tint on|off.

palette.title: Color set
palette.description: herbstglut: warm paper and lantern light, rose-pine: Rosé Pine Dawn and Moon, nord: Nord Snow Storm and Polar Night, custom: your own set chosen last (/tint <name>). Applies from the next chat; /tint <name> applies now.

language.title: Language / Sprache
language.description: Language of the texts. en: English, de: Deutsch. Also /tint language.
